items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There’s Dizzy Gillespie music, Benny Carter music, and Oliver Nelson music

ctx.x: faculty was the percussionist, composer, Warren Smith. Someone who works with me at the New School who just got promoted to full time, Richard Harper, a very wonderful vocal coach and trombonist. Numerous dancers and theatre people, they were all part of this program. I developed a course called Business of the Performing Arts that looked at music, dance, and theatre. I did lots of research, I bought lots of books about this stuff, interviewed people, had a little budget where I could bring people in from various…

I was writing articles about various aspects of the music business. You know, for people to understand about copyright and what copyright means for the, and the ownership of copyright and what that means for them and their families, and their grandchildren. I said to Arnie, “Alright, that’ll be good.” So, I developed a course on the business aspects of the music industry. What I had called my course all the time before, instead of just the business of music. There are many different aspects involved, so that’s…
